args.code: (() => { const all = document.querySelectorAll('div, span, li'); let result = []; for (let el of all) { const text = el.textContent.trim(); if (text === '商店' || text === '田地管理' || text === '房屋租赁' || text === '农具商店') { result.push({tag: el.tagName, class: el.className, text: text}); el.click(); } } return JSON.stringify(result); })()
